evidence.reason: The review payload still includes commit_id only when hunkMap is non-null. A body-only retry with hunks=null therefore omits commit_id; GitHub then associates the review with the PR's latest commit, while the body can still state the older reviewed range. That breaks the exact-head review requirement in contract item 18 and can misattribute findings if the head advances. Set commit_id from head regardless of inline-hunk availability, and fail rather than attach to another commit if GitHub rejects it.
